- Tue 8/10 10:00-11:00 PT
- Wed 8/11 10:00-11:00 PT
- Thu 8/12 13:00-14:00 PT

Calendar: https://cal.com/marissa/30 (if you prefer to pick an alternate time).

- Can Tower/GSI confirm what build artifacts or connectors they expect (container image or helm chart)?
- Any specific security or network constraints we should validate ahead of time (VPC peering, egress allowlists)?

Perfect — Wed 8/11 10:00-11:00 PT works for us. I've sent a calendar invite to all participants (link below).

We will include Tower (Akash) for connector details. For prep:
- Tower expects either a container image + manifest or a Helm chart; they prefer Helm for managed installs.
- Network: CloudBridge typically requires documented egress endpoints and allowslist ranges; we'll handle the marketplace-side firewall exceptions but will need your IP ranges.
- Listing metadata: CloudBridge product ops will manage the marketplace page; we'll need a short description, logo, and a customer-facing pricing blurb by Aug 18.

Invite: https://calendar.cloudbridge.com/event/CB-4521-technical-deep-dive
Doc: https://partner.cloudbridge.com/docs/integration-checklist (attached a condensed checklist).

Thanks,
Sophie
